run_generator_benchmark: run the metaseq generator benchmark CLI to measure latency and peak memory for a loaded model
run_main: run the main function to instantiate a generator interface, warm up, and benchmark generation performance
run_benchmark: run the benchmark function to measure generation latency and peak GPU memory across multiple repeats
run_profile: run the profile function to collect CPU and CUDA traces with tensorboard output for generation
review_benchmark: review the benchmark function that uses CUDA events to time generator.generate calls and report latency
